newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Tupperware buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tupperware buy reiterated.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Diana Temple lowered her 1997 earnings estimate on Tupperware Corp but reiterated a buy rating on the shares.
-- cut 1997 estimate to $2.95 per share from $3.10 following company's warning of weak first quarter results.
-- said company's turnaround plan, initiated last year, "will probably take 18 months instead of 12 months."
-- said underlying growth drivers remain in place and shares could reach $59, or 20 times 1997 earnings estimate.
